final: WITH account_sums AS (SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 AS region, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount END) AS account_sum, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM trans AS t JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3), region_totals AS (SELECT region, SUM(account_sum) AS region_total FROM account_sums GROUP BY region) SELECT s.account_id, s.region, s.account_sum, s.transaction_count, 1.0 * s.account_sum / NULLIF(r.region_total, 0) AS share FROM account_sums AS s JOIN region_totals AS r ON r.region = s.region ORDER BY share IS NULL, share DESC LIMIT 10
